Package aor.proj3t.service.impl

Class AIServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.impl.AIServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AIService
@ApplicationScoped public class AIServiceImpl extends Object implements AIService
Implementation of the AIService interface. This service provides integration with the AI microservice for various artificial intelligence operations including sentiment analysis, chatbot interactions, and AI-powered insights.

Key functionalities include:

  • Text sentiment analysis with polarity and subjectivity scores
  • Chatbot conversation management and response generation
  • AI-powered evaluation insights and recommendations
  • HTTP client integration with the AI microservice
  • JSON payload construction and response parsing

This service acts as a bridge between the main application and the AI microservice, handling request formatting, HTTP communication, and response parsing to provide seamless AI functionality integration.
